name: Standard Payments Capabilities (v1)
description: Standard semantics for AI-agent money movement and account operations: which transfer/payout/account/kyc/refund/limit capabilities are authorized, their amount ceilings (scalar number UPPER BOUNDS per CLC-v1 §6.2 (v1.1)) and allowlists (currency, counterparty, account = allowed-set ARRAYS). Scheme-scoped constraint types declared by this scheme: payments:quota:daily:<n> (cumulative daily quota). NOTE per CLC-v1 §8, unknown constraint types fail closed with deny("unknown_constraint"); CLC v1 decides single operations only and does not accumulate spend across requests.
author: varwof (open ecosystem)
note: IMPORTANT: This authorization layer defines the OPERATION BOUNDARY for an AI agent moving money. It is NOT an anti-fraud, risk, or clearing/settlement mechanism and does not replace the financial institution's own compliance controls (AML/CFT, sanctions, fraud detection, reconciliation). Allows authorize *whether* an operation may run today's system; risks and compliance remain with the financial institution.

capabilities.description: Transfer funds to an allowlisted counterparty
capabilities.summary: Move money within amount ceiling, currency and counterparty allowlist
capabilities.usage: Invoice payment, commission, refund execution by agents
capabilities.when_not: Must not grant without amount ceiling, currency set, and counterparty allowlist

capabilities.description: Initiate a payout to an external allowlisted counterparty
capabilities.summary: Disbursement with amount ceiling and counterparty allowlist
capabilities.when_not: High-value: must always carry a counterparty allowlist and bounded amount

capabilities.description: Open an account on an allowlisted account product
capabilities.summary: Create an account of an allowed type
capabilities.usage: Agent-assisted onboarding for approved product lines
capabilities.when_not: Must not grant unapproved account classes or bypass KYC gates

capabilities.description: Read KYC status for allowlisted accounts
capabilities.summary: Check KYC verification state before money movement
capabilities.when_not: Compliance gate: must only be granted after the counterparty KYC is verified

capabilities.summary: Reverse a payment within amount ceiling and counterparty allowlist
capabilities.when_not: Must not grant refunds beyond the original transaction amount

capabilities.description: Adjust a spending limit on an allowlisted account
capabilities.summary: Lower (or raise within cap) limits for an account
capabilities.usage: Treasury agents tuning account daily/spend limits
capabilities.when_not: Break-glass: raising limits should require human approval and audit
